headline: CALLAWAY APPROVED THE AD BEFORE IT WENT LIVE, THEN CALLED IT A MISTAKE
deck: A creator brand made a spot in which a man shoves a woman to the ground.  Callaway signed it off, it went out, it got pulled, and yesterday the chief executive apologised.  The apology is the interesting part, because he admitted the approval happened.
tldr: Callaway approved a Good Good Golf ad in which a man shoves a woman to the ground, pulled it, and its chief executive apologised yesterday while confirming the approval happened — in a market where female golfers grew 45% since 2020 against 12% for men.  Add one named person to your creator sign-off whose only job is to watch the cut cold, with no channel and no context, and give them a veto.

Jool Baby went from 5 units a day on Amazon to about 200 after TikTok videos it did not pay for, and sellers put the off-platform spillover at 1.5 to 3 times their TikTok volume even though TikTok Shop is only about 3% of their revenue.  Report branded search and direct sales for the seven days either side of every creator post alongside the in-app number.

Nielsen's quarterly numbers put streaming at 48.2% of ad-supported viewing across everyone aged two and up, but at 44.4% among adults 18 and over, with broadcast and cable each about two points higher.  Re-run your last television and streaming split on the 18-plus base before your next planning meeting.

Fortnite's Esports World Cup audience peaked at 422,600 and is being reported as up 481.6%, on a broadcast that ran across 194 channels this year against 49 in 2024, with average concurrents not published at all.  Ask any livestream seller for average concurrent viewers, airtime and channel count for both years, and price off the average.

Neutrogena disabled the comments on its apology post and the criticism moved everywhere else, six days later the promised community health investment still has no details, and the same brand handled a smaller mistake well the same month by replying with comments open.  Write a standing rule that comments stay on for every brand apology and staff someone to answer in the thread for the first 24 hours.

Nobody at most agencies owns YouTube Shorts — video, search, social and the automated buying teams all half-claim it — so Google phones whichever budget is easiest to open and the format never accumulates a benchmark.  Name one person as the owner of Shorts spend for four quarters, give them the budget line and one reporting benchmark, and make them present it every quarter.

Apachho Singh did 455,180,875 views in a single week off 4.5 million subscribers, jumping to number 18 on views and number 38 on subscriber gain at the same time, two days before Raksha Bandhan on 28 August.  If you sell snacks, drinks, personal care or festival gifting in India, get a quote from them this week while the rate card is still anchored to the subscriber count.
